notes: New 'Sync seats from Stripe' button in Settings → Products → Overview. Click it once and every Stripe seat you've purchased gets a matching bundle row in your backend — the per-tenant Assignment tab finally has slots to surface. Idempotent: safe to click repeatedly after every new purchase

Backend: new POST /api/local/bundles/sync-from-stripe endpoint. Each Stripe subscription item becomes one signed BundleRow with slot counts = quantity. Deterministic JTI from the Stripe item id so re-runs upsert in place instead of duplicating
